message: Stream 'fund.fee_on_distributions' reads series 'fund.distribution.residual', which is a waterfall step. Steps publish when their waterfall finishes, and every waterfall runs after every stream — so this read could only ever aggregate to zero.
hint: A step's series is visible to a later waterfall's `from` and to nothing else. Model the quantity the step pays as a stream or a field if a stream needs to read it.
